description: Tadpoles with experimentally misplaced jaws and branchial arches corrected their shape and position over the first months of development, with misplaced structures moving along paths that differ from normal movements.
limitations: The authors infer a measuring mechanism from morphometrics, it is not directly observed.

sources.quote: the shapes and relative positions of perturbed jaws and branchial arches were corrected during the first few months of tadpole development
